svg.text: SEAL THE DEAL / OFFICE LAYOUT STUDY
FLOW / ring, routes, gates and sightlines / TARGET CONCEPT / 15 NOV 2026
A dependable ring; a visible court; two inhabited cores; three routes through the office.
40 px/m / 4m grid / NW origin / plan y = Unity -Z
Doors 1.2 x 2.4m / floor rise 4.5m / slab 0.2m / soffit 4.3m / cage continuous above ramp.
Ring = pale blue; loops = blue dash; B = shared case; gates = red dash, not decorative glass.
Frost bands / clear at eye height
G1 G2 GF / upper gate apertures
Gates shown as UPPER arrival traces.
Lower floor is open; void exists above.
Glass bridge deck is NOT overhead cover.
DASHED BLUE = main loop CIRCLES = nodes DIAMONDS = landmarks B = shared briefcase start
Dashed arrows: F exposed / E1-E2 enclosed / L reserved shaft only. Time estimates exclude combat and turning.
